name: Uveron
description: Uveron was a planet located in the Colonies. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma undertook a funding mission for the Alliance to the world. During her time on Uveron, Mothma was kidnapped by the Scarabi.
lead_paragraphs: Uveron was a planet located in the Colonies. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma undertook a funding mission for the Alliance to the world. During her time on Uveron, Mothma was kidnapped by the Scarabi.
